# Orspex Jobs

> A free job board connecting job seekers with employers. No fees, no games, just real work.

## What this site offers
- Free job postings for employers
- One-click applications for job seekers
- Application tracking dashboard
- No subscription fees

## Key pages
- [Home](https://orspex-jobs-seeking.vercel.app/): Landing page
- [Browse Jobs](https://orspex-jobs-seeking.vercel.app/jobs): All open positions
- [Post a Job](https://orspex-jobs-seeking.vercel.app/jobs/new): For employers
- [Login](https://orspex-jobs-seeking.vercel.app/login): Sign in
- [Register](https://orspex-jobs-seeking.vercel.app/register): Create an account
